summary_1line: Ravana shows Sita the splendor of his palace and urges her to become his queen, boasting of his power and belittling Rama.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana leads the sorrowful Sita up a magnificent golden stairway inside a gem-studded palace while demon women surround her.
Inside the glittering halls of Lanka, Ravana boasts before Sita as she stands with bowed head, weeping and covering her moonlike face with her robe.
Ravana gestures toward lotus-filled pools and jeweled fountains of his palace while the grieving Sita looks on in silence.
